description: This file provides stub implementations for Ethernet Switch control functions, including port status, configuration, admin status, and MAC address location, for the CCSP component. It includes functions for initializing the Ethernet switch, retrieving and setting port configurations, and locating ports by MAC address.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwInit
methods.description: Initializes the Ethernet switch hardware or driver.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwGetPortStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current link speed, duplex mode, and link status for a specified port.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwGetPortCfg
methods.description: Retrieves current port configuration including link rate and duplex mode.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwSetPortCfg
methods.description: Sets port configuration such as link speed and duplex mode.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwGetPortAdminStatus
methods.description: Retrieves administrative status (up/down) of a port.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwSetPortAdminStatus
methods.description: Sets administrative status (up/down) of a port.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwSetAgingSpeed
methods.description: Sets aging speed for a port.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwLocatePortByMacAddress
methods.description: Finds the port associated with a given MAC address.

methods.name: CcspHalExtSw_getAssociatedDevice
methods.description: Retrieves devices associated with the switch.
